data.title: Silver's knife
data.summary: Blades & scalpels · Smaller version of Humby's knife that takes a disposable shaving (razor) blade.
data.body:
![Silver's knife](instruments/silvers-knife.jpg)

_Also called: Silver skin graft knife, Miniature dermatome_

Smaller version of Humby's knife that takes a disposable shaving (razor) blade.

## Parts
- Handle
- Clamp holding an ordinary disposable shaving blade
- Screws to adjust graft thickness

## Uses / indications
- Harvesting small, thin split-thickness grafts
- Grafts from awkward areas (dorsa of hands, face, scalp) where Humby's knife cannot reach

## How to hold
Like Humby's knife, held flat to the stretched skin with gentle sawing strokes.

## Sterilisation & care
Autoclave, hot air oven, 2% glutaraldehyde

## Viva points & tips
- Cheap: uses ordinary razor blades
